name: Sakhibaghoon
isnote: PBDB places it in Tomistominae; the group's gavialoid/tomistomine status is debated; placed in Gavialoidea.
sum: Sakhibaghoon is a crocodylian named in 2022 from the Late Miocene Litra Formation of Pakistan.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Litra Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
